use default

primes() -> Pipe[int] is
    let found = LIST[int]()
    let candidate mut = 1

    do
        candidate = candidate + 1

        let divisible mut = false

        for divisor in found do
            if divisor * divisor > candidate then break fi

            if candidate % divisor == 0 then
                divisible = true
                break
            fi
        od

        if !divisible then
            found.add(candidate)
            yield candidate
        fi
    od
si

digit_sum(value: int) -> int =>
    if value < 10 then value else value % 10 + digit_sum(value / 10) fi

honakers() -> Pipe[(position: int, prime: int)] is
    let position mut = 0

    for prime in primes() do
        position = position + 1

        if digit_sum(position) == digit_sum(prime) then
            yield (position = position, prime = prime)
        fi
    od
si

write_line("the first fifty Honaker primes:")

let first_fifty = honakers() |> take(50) |> collect_list()

for row in 0..10 do
    let cells =
        first_fifty[row * 5..row * 5 + 5]
            |> map(h => "{h.position,7}:{h.prime,8}")

    write_line(cells |> join(""))
od

let ten_thousandth =
    for entry in honakers() |> index() do
        if entry.index == 9_999 then break entry.value fi
    od

write_line("")
write_line("the ten thousandth is at position {ten_thousandth!.position}, "
           "and is {ten_thousandth.prime}")
